pedal: Boss RV-6 Reverb, stereo (Input A -> Outputs A and B)

method.response: pedal channel / loopback: a burst take (time-invariant modes) over the whole take, marker included; sweeps and the moving modes from the signal on
method.wet: response / (bypass dry IR windowed -2..+8 ms) - 1, tapered to 40 Hz-16 kHz
method.rt60: 2.85-3.1 kHz notched (the pedal's whine), octave bands (4th-order Butterworth, zero-phase), Schroeder with the noise floor subtracted, T30 (T20 where marked); bursts only 500 Hz-4 kHz
method.burst_irs: Room, Hall, Plate and Spring are time-invariant, so the burst takes (marker + burst) deconvolve to impulse responses
